hack.root_cause: Compromised multisig private keys → malicious contract upgrade → pool ownership transfer → drain
hack.description: An attacker compromised 3 of Radiant Capital's 11 multisig keys, used them to transfer lending pool ownership to a malicious contract deployed 14 days earlier, and drained $53M — all while the team stayed silent for 2 hours.
